name: Qatar

fees.name: Hayya Tourist Visa (A1) e-visa
fees.validity: 30 days stay (extendable); enter within validity shown on approval
fees.applies: all nationalities except GCC citizens and visa-exempt travellers
fees.notes: QAR 100 paid upon final approval via the official Hayya portal (hayya.qa); fee can be exempted under certain conditions (e.g. Discover Qatar hotel booking promotions).

fees.name: Hayya GCC Resident Visa (A2)
fees.applies: residents of GCC countries (any nationality) holding valid GCC residence permits
fees.notes: Applied online via Hayya portal before travel.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.validity: 30 or 90 days depending on nationality (waiver tiers)
fees.notes: Many eligible nationalities (incl. Schengen, UK, US, Canada, Australia, NZ) enter under the visa-waiver programme at no charge; the QAR 100 on-arrival fee applies where charged, and can be waived with a hotel booking through Discover Qatar.

fees.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA)
fees.applies: travellers holding valid residence permits/visas of certain countries (e.g. GCC, Schengen, UK, US)
fees.notes: ETA listed on MOI Qatar Visas portal (issued via Hayya); no fee published on the official page - MOI/Hayya do not state a charge, widely reported as free but not verified on an official source, so amount left null.

fees.name: Qatar transit visa (96 hours, Qatar Airways passengers)
fees.applies: Qatar Airways passengers with 5-96 hour layovers, 100+ eligible nationalities
fees.notes: Free of charge; both flight legs must be on Qatar Airways. Standalone application reportedly routed through Manage Booking / Discover Qatar stopover packages.

fees.name: Business visit visa (sponsor-arranged)
fees.applies: business visitors sponsored by a Qatari company
fees.notes: Arranged by the Qatari host company via MOI; MOI does not publish a public fee schedule for business visit visas online, so amount left null rather than estimated (unofficial sources cite roughly QAR 200 single-entry).

fees.name: Visa-Free for US Citizens (F1) one-time entry fee
fees.validity: 2 years or until passport expiry (whichever first), multiple entries, up to 90 days per stay
fees.notes: One-time fee of USD 21 / QAR 76 paid on first entry, or via the Hayya 'Visa-Free for US Citizens (F1)' pre-registration.

reciprocity_variations.note: Covered by Qatar's visa-waiver programme (102+ nationalities): free entry on arrival, no visa fee. IND/PHL/RUS/CHN are on the 30-day waiver tier; Schengen nationals get 90 days.
Not on the visa-waiver list; must obtain the Hayya Tourist Visa (A1) for QAR 100 before travel.

vfs.note: Tourist/visit visas are issued directly online via the official Hayya portal (hayya.qa) with no outsourced service centre. Qatar Visa Centres (QVC) abroad handle work-visa biometrics only, which is outside this record's scope.

free_visa_notes: Citizens of 102+ countries (Schengen, UK, US, Canada, Australia, NZ, India, and others) enter Qatar visa-free / free-on-arrival under the visa-waiver programme; GCC nationals need no visa at all.
